package ap

// ddsonic composed-stage reconnect gate (M3B2-S4 fixture bundle, RB-1; plan
// v9 §8 I8, I13/I14). ACTIVE STAGE ONLY: it uses the patched SDK's
// per-access-point key-provider announcer and connection generation (patch
// 0002), which the authenticated base v0.9.1 of the stock stage does not
// have. It is mapped only in the composed stage's composedFiles and is never
// part of the stock O. Like the other composed helpers it exists only in the
// overlay built over a staged copy of go-librespot: no shipped SDK byte
// changes, and ap_fake_helper.go.txt (H/) is not edited.
//
// H/'s DDSonicContractGateWrites gates only a connection whose receive loop
// has not started: in the composed stage, an access point's first
// (generation 1) connection. DDSonicComposedGateGeneration puts H/'s same
// DDSonicWriteGate (open; its Fail, Arm and Release work as in H/) on the
// connection that becomes generation gen of one access point a, inside that
// very publication:
//   - connect publishes a generation with a.connMu.Lock held: it calls
//     announceLocked, which calls a's OWN announcer (a field of a), before
//     the generation is stored and its channel closed (ap.go :138-147,
//     :302-329);
//   - on a reconnect, the receive loop for the new connection starts only
//     after connect returns (ap.go :527-545), and every write selects its
//     connection under a.connMu.RLock (SendStamped, :352-363), so a write on
//     the new connection, and its reader, both follow the gate's
//     installation;
//   - the old connection was closed by init when the new one was dialled
//     (:180-190); it is not touched.
// Attribution is by construction: only a's own publications call a's
// announcer. The package's global testHookStageAfterAnnounce, which has no
// access point argument, is not used.
//
// The original announcer is called first, with the same generation, and is
// restored the moment the gate is applied (or the arming found disarmed), so
// the key provider's announcement, the generation's storage and its channel
// are unchanged. Nothing is armed by default: an access point nobody armed
// is never touched. No goroutine is started, and no package global is
// written.

import (
	"errors"
	"sync"
	"sync/atomic"
)

// DDSonicComposedRegate is one armed generation of one access point.
type DDSonicComposedRegate struct {
	// Gate is H/'s write gate, applied at the armed generation's
	// publication. Fail and Arm may be called before then.
	Gate *DDSonicWriteGate

	gen      uint64
	applied  chan struct{}
	once     sync.Once
	disarmed atomic.Bool
}

// Applied is closed once the gate is on the armed generation's connection.
func (r *DDSonicComposedRegate) Applied() <-chan struct{} { return r.applied }

// Disarm makes an arming that has not been applied inert. It is idempotent
// and takes no lock (T1).
func (r *DDSonicComposedRegate) Disarm() { r.disarmed.Store(true) }

// DDSonicComposedGateGeneration arms H/'s write gate for the connection that
// becomes generation gen of a. gen must be after a's current generation, and
// a must already have its key provider's announcer (an owner provider): an
// arming that would change either is refused. It takes a.connMu.Lock, so it
// must never be called from a callback that runs under it.
func DDSonicComposedGateGeneration(a *Accesspoint, gen uint64) (*DDSonicComposedRegate, error) {
	a.connMu.Lock()
	defer a.connMu.Unlock()
	if cur := a.gen.Load().gen; gen <= cur {
		return nil, errors.New("ddsonic composed: the generation to gate is not after the access point's current one")
	}
	orig := a.announcer
	if orig == nil {
		return nil, errors.New("ddsonic composed: the access point has no key-provider announcer to compose with")
	}
	r := &DDSonicComposedRegate{Gate: &DDSonicWriteGate{}, gen: gen, applied: make(chan struct{})}
	a.announcer = func(next uint64) {
		orig(next) // the product's announcement, unchanged
		if r.disarmed.Load() {
			a.announcer = orig
			return
		}
		if next != r.gen {
			return
		}
		r.once.Do(func() {
			// a.connMu.Lock is held by this publication (announceLocked's
			// caller); nothing here takes a lock of a's or waits.
			r.Gate.Conn = a.conn
			a.conn = r.Gate
			a.encConn.conn = r.Gate
			a.announcer = orig
			close(r.applied)
		})
	}
	return r, nil
}

// DDSonicComposedAnnounceHold is one armed hold of one access point's
// publication of one generation (M3B2-S5, G2; plan v9 §8 I30): held after
// that generation's announcement to the key provider and before its store,
// the point the SDK contract's S37 holds with the package-global
// testHookStageAfterAnnounce, which names no access point. Here, as for
// DDSonicComposedRegate, only a's own publications call a's announcer, so
// the hold is attributed to a by construction.
type DDSonicComposedAnnounceHold struct {
	gen      uint64
	reached  chan struct{}
	release  chan struct{}
	relOnce  sync.Once
	disarmed atomic.Bool
}

// Reached is closed when the armed generation's publication has announced
// it and is held before its store.
func (x *DDSonicComposedAnnounceHold) Reached() <-chan struct{} { return x.reached }

// Release lets the held publication store its generation and close the old
// channel; it is idempotent and takes no lock (T1).
func (x *DDSonicComposedAnnounceHold) Release() { x.relOnce.Do(func() { close(x.release) }) }

// Disarm makes an arming that has not been reached inert. It is idempotent
// and takes no lock (T1).
func (x *DDSonicComposedAnnounceHold) Disarm() { x.disarmed.Store(true) }

// DDSonicComposedHoldAnnouncement arms a hold of a's publication of
// generation gen, after the key provider's announcement (the original
// announcer runs first, with the same generation, unchanged) and before the
// store (ap.go :138-147). While it is held, a.connMu.Lock stays held by
// that publication, exactly as under S37's hook: a write's selection
// (SendStamped's RLock) waits for the release; Generation stays lock-free
// and reports the previous generation. The original announcer is restored
// before the hold waits, or as soon as an arming is found disarmed. gen
// must be after a's current generation, and a must already have its key
// provider's announcer; one arming (this or DDSonicComposedGateGeneration)
// per access point at a time. It takes a.connMu.Lock, so it must never be
// called from a callback that runs under it. It starts no goroutine and
// writes no package global.
func DDSonicComposedHoldAnnouncement(a *Accesspoint, gen uint64) (*DDSonicComposedAnnounceHold, error) {
	a.connMu.Lock()
	defer a.connMu.Unlock()
	if cur := a.gen.Load().gen; gen <= cur {
		return nil, errors.New("ddsonic composed: the generation to hold is not after the access point's current one")
	}
	orig := a.announcer
	if orig == nil {
		return nil, errors.New("ddsonic composed: the access point has no key-provider announcer to compose with")
	}
	x := &DDSonicComposedAnnounceHold{gen: gen, reached: make(chan struct{}), release: make(chan struct{})}
	a.announcer = func(next uint64) {
		orig(next) // the product's announcement, unchanged
		if x.disarmed.Load() {
			a.announcer = orig
			return
		}
		if next != x.gen {
			return
		}
		// a.connMu.Lock is held by this publication (announceLocked's
		// caller); the store waits for the release, as under S37's hook.
		a.announcer = orig
		close(x.reached)
		<-x.release
	}
	return x, nil
}
